ideas.name: BOJ ETF buying lifts afternoon TOPIX return
ideas.claim: On days the BOJ buys ETFs, afternoon stock returns rise and volatility falls (QQE period).
ideas.quote: 日銀のETF買い入れにより株価リターンは午後に上昇し、ボラティリティは低下、予想株式益回りと安全資産利子率の差で表されるイールドスプレッドは縮小していたことが確認できた。

rules.filters: BOJ reference: TOPIX return from prior close to morning close, deviation of morning close from 5-day moving average, morning realized volatility

ideas.claimed_result: Afternoon returns higher, volatility lower on BOJ ETF buy days; no numbers given

ideas.name: BOJ ETF buying short-term price lift, lending-market decay
ideas.claim: BOJ ETF purchases lift stock prices short term; the effect weakens as more shares enter the lending market, for stocks with high lending fees.
ideas.quote: 日銀によるETF買入れは短期的には株価を押し上げる効果を持ちます。

rules.filters: securities lending fee, lendable share count

ideas.claimed_result: not stated (no quantitative estimate on page)
required_data: stock-level lending fees and lendable shares
